title: Herbal Wisdom Gathering
description: Three African women sit at a stone table adorned with scattered papers and yellow petals. The woman on the left holds a glowing green potion bottle, the center woman rests her hands on the table, and the woman on the right reads an open book with floral illustrations. Above them, a large green serpent with a flaming head coils around a central pillar beneath a flowering tree branch where two yellow birds perch.
prompt: Three dark-skinned African women wearing vibrant blue and red patterned dresses and matching headwraps sit together at a round stone table. One holds a glowing green potion bottle, another reads an open book with plant illustrations, while the third watches. A large emerald green serpent with a flaming head coils around a central pillar. Flowering tree branches with two yellow birds hang above, with colorful glowing lanterns suspended from them. Scattered papers and yellow flower petals cover the table. Lush, mystical garden background with soft light, rich vibrant colors.
